notes: Group B re-check of the 11 stored BR competitors on their own sites only; no web searches made. Unreadable (HTTP 403 to the page reader, retried once each): Simpliza, SisFood, Anota AI; their stored rows and prices were left as they are. Eligible food-truck tools with a price: Food Pronto (R$ 200/mês; the stored plan name 'Plano único' could not be re-read because /precos renders by script) and VexMenu (R$0 + 2,99% Pix online / R$299 / R$499 + R$200 setup). Food Pronto's order-ahead evidence is thin: customers find nearby trucks, order by phone and collect at the counter when alerted; no chosen pickup time is stated. Because BR has 2 eligible food-truck tools, under the 24 Nov rule the restaurant tools (Goomer, Pedizap, Cardápio Web) may not count; they are recorded as eligible nearest_local with order-ahead quotes so the reviewer can decide. Goomer has 4 plans; 3 are recorded, and Integrar R$ 299,90/mês is in the note. VirtualLine and OlaClick are BORDERLINE not_relevant (see each reason): VirtualLine is QR-at-the-truck plus a virtual queue; OlaClick showed no pickup or advance-order wording and still has USD-only plan prices. The R$ 825/mês on its pt-br page is a calculator figure. Soften Food names food trucks (offline mobile sales) but shows no customer order-ahead and no price.
